task_title: density filter, projection, beta continuation, symmetry, mask, min linewidth/gap, fabrication perturbation, binary export를 실제 검사와 연결한다

physics_configuration.gap_violation: tests/test_design_workflow.py: 12 x 12 logits of +-8 forming two solid blocks (columns 1..4 and 6..10 of rows 1..10) separated by one 0.1 um pixel, DensityParameterization with filter_radius_um 0.15, truncate boundary, beta 64, eta 0.5; DesignProblem with a linear objective (density times a linspace weight); fabrication(spacing 0.1 um, min_linewidth 0.15 um, min_gap 0.15 um, perturbation 0.1 um)
physics_configuration.feature_measurement: tests/test_design_workflow.py: 30 x 1 periodic line with runs of 4, 1 and 8 pixels (0.05 um); 12 x 12 blocks of 5 x 5 and 4 x 5 pixels one pixel apart at the array edge (0.1 um), measured with extend and periodic boundaries; a uniform 5 x 5 design
physics_configuration.binary_export: tests/test_design_workflow.py: 6 x 5 binary with three rectangular runs, origin (-0.6, -0.5) um, 0.2 um pixels, z from -0.1 to 0.1 um
physics_configuration.examples: the fabrication reports of examples/design_metagrating.py (spacing 0.05 um, declared min linewidth and gap 0.1 um, perturbation 0.05 um, periodic x) and examples/design_mode_coupler.py (spacing 0.2 um, declared 0.4 um, perturbation 0.2 um) as run by the G6-05 end-to-end tests and the G6-07 recorded starts
physics_configuration.measurement: torchfdtd.fabrication: opening by digital squares of every integer side (odd sides centred on a pixel, even sides on a corner); the minimum linewidth is the largest side whose opening leaves the solid unchanged, the minimum gap the same on the void; erosion and dilation by the square of side 2 amount + 1

reference_method: Analytic discrete morphology: a run of L pixels or a rectangle of W by H pixels survives the opening with side s exactly when min(W, H) >= s, so the measured values are known by construction (linewidth 4, gap 1 for the gap-violation blocks; 4 and 6 for the periodic line; 5 and 1 with extend, 4 with periodic for the edge blocks). The perturbation changes are the forward model's own responses to the eroded and dilated designs; they are recorded and required to be finite and nonzero, not compared to an external value.
